# Plant Growth Study

- Treat the `data/` folder as read-only: never modify raw CSV files.
- Save cleaned CSV copies only in the `clean/` folder.
- Write Python analysis using built-in modules and `matplotlib` only, unless the group explicitly approves another package.
- Label every graph axis with units: use `cm` for length and `days` for time.
- For each statistical method, explain it in one plain-English sentence and state the assumption it makes about the data.
- Do not include any personal information about lab members.
